examples.arabic: هو كان لابس قميص كحلي غامق وانا كنت لابس تيشيرت ملون
examples.english: He was wearing a dark navy blue shirt and I was wearing a colored tshirt.
examples.transliteration: howa kan labes amees kohli ghamek wa ana kont labes teshert melawen

examples.arabic: اشترينا لها فستان حلو لونه كحلي عشان هي بتحب الوان غامقة
examples.english: We bought her a nice dress, its color is navy blue, because she likes dark colors.
examples.transliteration: eshtareyna laha fostaan helw lono kohli ashan heyya betheb alwaan ghamqa

examples.arabic: البياع وراني جلابيه كحلي وواحده تانيه اسود
examples.english: The seller showed me a navy blue galabeya and another black one.
examples.transliteration: el bayyaa waraani galabiyya kuhli wa wahda tanya iswid
